WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bats AS batting_hand,
    COUNT(*) AS hand_count
  FROM fielding f
  JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(hand_count) AS total_count FROM hand_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(hand_count) AS avg_count FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT 
  hc.batting_hand,
  hc.hand_count AS count,
  hc.hand_count::float / t.total_count AS share,
  hc.hand_count::float - a.avg_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts hc
CROSS JOIN total t
CROSS JOIN averages a
WHERE hc.hand_count > a.avg_count
ORDER BY hc.hand_count DESC
